sermon.title: How Does Jesus Show His Approval When His Followers are Divided? — August 23, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that divisions reveal who is approved. God showed His approval in Absalom’s defeat and in Jerusalem’s fall in AD 70, which he identifies as the one great tribulation. He traces a falling away in church history and the remnant God always preserves. Believers must decide to be that remnant.
